newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 2.79 pct up on speculation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 2.79 pct up on speculation.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 2.79 percent up on Wednesday on speculative buying of index weighted scrips sparked on a 7.86 percent rupee devaluation and government's tough economic package, dealers said.

"Speculators have pushed up the prices on low volumes. But the rise is temporary as there is little foreign or genuine buying," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "PTCL and Hub Power, which have GDRs (Global Depositary Receipts) rose to match their prices abroad." The Karachi 100-share index rose 38.94 points, to end at 1,432.57. Gainers led losers 152 to 65. Hub Power rose 1.45 rupees to 33.80. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
